notes: New: watch Z.ai think and answer LIVE in your project chat - a collapsible Thinking section, the partial answer as it streams, the latest tool/step line, phase and elapsed time, refreshed about once a second. The current model (read from chat.z.ai's own label) shows in the chat header and engine picker, and the new model picker lists the options from chat.z.ai's own dropdown: picking one drives the hidden page and is verified by reading the label back, with a clear message and the read-only label if automation ever fails. Your pick is remembered. Sign-in, NEED_FILES, review-and-apply and the prompt budget are unchanged; the three CLI agents are untouched. Same signing key - installs over 1.0.26 with one tap.
